item-01.reason: Passes alone 10/10 but fails after the admin test because cy.session with cacheAcrossSpecs restored the admin session for a viewer test.

item-02.reason: The alert renders only when allergens is non-empty, the fixture recipe has none, and the assertion runs unconditionally.

item-03.reason: Duration near the 4000ms defaultCommandTimeout, search API responded 200 at 3960ms, passes on retry, client-rendered page.

item-04.reason: First click after visit on a server-rendered Nuxt page dispatched at 540ms before hydration at 1020ms, no POST fired, passes on retry.

item-05.reason: Fails only in the 800x600 CI project where the button collapses into the overflow menu below 960px; passes at 1280x720 locally.

item-06.reason: The transient toast mounted and was removed at 1500ms before cy.get started at 1640ms because the screenshot delayed the query.

item-07.reason: storageState token expired on 2026-09-27, before the run on 2026-10-03; /api/me returns 401 and the page redirects to login.

item-08.reason: Duration matches the 15000ms timeout, the seats API completed at 14902ms, outcome is flaky, and the page is client-rendered.

item-09.reason: Opacity was read at 948ms, partway through a 600ms CSS transition (0.42), so it was a one-shot read before the animation finished.

item-10.reason: The seed creates only Modern Glass and Textiles of the Andes, so the hardcoded 'Ancient Pottery' exhibit does not exist.

item-11.reason: A blanket uncaught:exception handler returning false suppressed an exception; the audit surfaced it, while the product rendered normally.

item-12.reason: Fails only in CI at 1000x660, below the 1024px breakpoint that hides topbar links behind a hamburger; passes at 1280 locally.

item-13.reason: A commit replaced id='adopt-now' with data-cy, but the custom command in commands.js still selects #adopt-now.

item-14.reason: First click after goto on an SSR Next.js page at 610ms came before hydration at 1040ms, with no POST and a pass on retry.

item-15.reason: The fixture hardcodes mem_301, which the seed lacks (only mem_401/402), so the API returns 404.

item-16.reason: The cached cy.session token expired 2026-09-25, before the 2026-10-03 run; /api/session returns 401 and the page redirects to login.

item-17.reason: Submit completed and POST returned ok, but the persisted grade still reads draft after reload, so the action left the wrong state.

item-18.reason: Passes alone 10/10 and fails after the add-book test because a worker-scoped memberPage fixture leaks the reading-list entry.

item-19.reason: The .btn-primary selector matches two buttons and has been ambiguous since the page shipped, with no DOM drift.

item-20.reason: cy.intercept was registered at 244ms, after GET /api/permits completed at 181ms, because it was declared after cy.visit.

item-21.reason: The contract expects 2 overdue days, but the API itself returns overdue_days 3 and the UI shows it, a value mismatch from the backend (cy.clock does not affect the server).

item-22.reason: A commit removed id='assign-vehicle', but the RentalPage.ts POM locator was not updated.

item-23.reason: AC-3 requires 10% member discount, but the cart API reports discount_applied false and total 50.00 for a member.

item-24.reason: The app's own itinerary API returned 500 'database connection refused' on both attempts; the intercept matched.

item-25.reason: The application's events API returned 502 on both attempts, so no list items rendered; there is no test-side routing.

item-26.reason: Strict mode violation: the Archive button name resolves to 3 elements, and the selector has been ambiguous since it was written.

item-27.reason: The late-fee notice renders only when late_fee_cents > 0, the fixture has 0, and the assertion runs unconditionally.

item-28.reason: The helper's .catch(() => {}) swallows the assertion rejection; the audit caught it while the product behaves correctly.

item-29.reason: The archive POST returned ok, but the task list still reports archived false and the UI still shows the task after reload.

item-30.reason: The download event fired at 311ms, before waitForEvent was registered at 340ms; the listener was registered after the click instead of via Promise.all.
